description: Place an order. THIS SPENDS THE USER'S REAL BALANCE (USD) and starts delivery to the link; it cannot be undone except by cancel_order where the service allows it. Before calling: get the price with get_quote and get the user's explicit agreement to that price. Then call with `confirm: true`. Without `confirm: true` nothing is charged and you get the price back so you can ask. `dry_run: true` validates everything (link fits the service, quantity range, key limits) and returns price, balance and whether it is enough — never charges. Pass a fresh `idempotency_key` per intended order so a retry never charges twice. Errors: insufficient_balance (details.shortfall = USD to top up — call get_top_up_info), over_order_cap / over_daily_cap / platform_not_allowed / read_only_key (this key's limits), wrong_platform, bad_quantity, link_busy (too many running on that link: details.available), chain_not_supported. Services with an `input` (find_services) take their fields in `inputs`: `comments` (custom comments, one per line or a list — their number is the quantity), `usernames` (accounts to mention), `hashtag`, `username`, `answer_number` (poll option, 1 = first), `runs` + `interval` (spread out; quantity is per run), or subscription terms (`min`, `max`, `posts`, `old_posts`, `delay`, `expiry`: auto-engagement on future posts, paid up front for at most max × posts). Text we post for the user is checked first: text_blocked = refused, nothing charged; a dry run says `text_review: true` when our team may check it before it starts. Errors also: bad_inputs, inputs_required. Done-for-you services (kind "manual": listings) need a form with images — those are ordered on the website.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually place and charge. Only after the user agreed to the price.

dry_run.description: true = validate and price only, never charge.

idempotency_key.description: Unique string per intended order; a retry with the same key returns the first order.

inputs.description: Order fields, for services with an `input` (see find_services).

answer_number.description: Poll votes: the option to vote for, 1 = the first.

comments.description: Custom comments: one per line, or a list. Their number is the quantity.

delay.description: Subscriptions: minutes after a post goes up before it starts (0, 5, 10 … 600).

hashtag.description: Mentions by hashtag: one hashtag, e.g. "#yourbrand".

max.description: Subscriptions: the most each new post gets.

min.description: Subscriptions: the least each new post gets.

old_posts.description: Subscriptions: also this many of the latest posts (0–50).

posts.description: Subscriptions: how many future posts it covers (1–500).

runs.description: Spread the order over this many runs (2–100); `quantity` is then per run.

username.description: An account: whose followers get mentioned, whose comment gets the likes, or a subscription’s account.

usernames.description: Mentions: the accounts to mention, one per line, or a list. Their number is the quantity.

link.description: The URL to deliver to. Must fit the service (e.g. a profile link for followers).

quantity.description: How many units. Leave out where the inputs count it (comments, usernames) or it is fixed (packages, subscriptions).

name: place_order
title: Place an order (spends balance)
